from geopy.distance import geodesic

# Function to calculate the distance between two points
def calculate_distance(station, institution):
    return geodesic(station, institution).meters

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query to get the centroids of HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas
query_health_care_institutions = text("""
SELECT id, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS centroid
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
""")

# Execute the query and store the results in a DataFrame
health_care_institutions_df = pd.read_sql(query_health_care_institutions, engine)

# Query to get the coordinates of GENERAL-type air-quality stations
query_general_stations = text("""
SELECT id, coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL'
""")

# Execute the query and store the results in a DataFrame
general_stations_df = pd.read_sql(query_general_stations, engine)

# Calculate the distances between each health care institution centroid and each general station
query_distances = text("""
SELECT h.id AS health_care_id, g.id AS station_id, ST_Distance(h.centroid::geography, g.coordinate::geography) AS distance
FROM (
    SELECT id, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS centroid
    FROM sensitive_area
    WHERE category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
) h,
(
    SELECT id, coordinate
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE station_type = 'GENERAL'
) g
WHERE ST_DWithin(h.centroid::geography, g.coordinate::geography, 3000)
""")

# Execute the query and store the results in a DataFrame
distances_df = pd.read_sql(query_distances, engine)

# Count the number of distinct health care institutions within 3000 meters of at least one general station
health_general_3km_count = distances_df['health_care_id'].nunique()
